name: Touradj Ebrahimi
one_sentence_summary: Touradj Ebrahimi leads EPFL's MMSPG, focusing on AI-powered image/video coding, JPEG standardization (JPEG AI, JPEG Trust, JPEG XE, JPEG DNA), media security, and fine-grained quality assessment.
matrix_summary: MMSPG has published three new papers at SPIE (Oct 2026) covering facial privacy (FaceShield), a new JPEG XE standard for event-based vision systems, and fact-checking within JPEG Trust — plus a new arXiv preprint on event-guided neural video compression. The JPEG AI IEEE Multimedia paper has surged to 37 citations.
